name: FORGE testing dataset
purpose: Repeatable functionality testing for FORGE ingestion, multimodal retrieval, and grounded answering. This is not a production corpus.
redistribution: JA-Business-Doc-RQ-Bench files are Apache-2.0 and included with attribution. VIXIO images and masks are local-only until redistribution terms are confirmed.

ja_business_doc_rq_bench.ground_truth: The source metadata includes one question, expected answer, answer type, and reasoning-step count for each selected image.
ja_business_doc_rq_bench.license: Apache-2.0 per source README; retain source attribution.

vixio_metal_nut.ground_truth: 18 paired ground-truth mask images are included for color, reverse, and scratches defects. Good samples have no paired mask in the archive.
vixio_metal_nut.license: Not recorded in the project. Verify Mitsubishi Electric sample-archive terms before redistribution.

industrial_dataset.source_note: The repository did not record a download URL for this file.
industrial_dataset.ground_truth: The CSV contains a Target column; no separate ground-truth file included.
industrial_dataset.license: Existing project fixture; no external redistribution terms recorded.
